title: Field Network Incident Response
description: Field network failures affecting construction site operations
triggers: Complete field network outage at construction sites
Network performance degradation affecting site operations
immediate_actions: Identify scope of network failure (single site vs multi-site)
Notify site managers of connectivity status
investigation_steps: Check network device status at affected sites
Verify ISP connectivity and circuit status
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Coordinate with ISP for circuit issues
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
verification: Test network connectivity at affected construction sites
Confirm with site staff that network is operational
special_considerations: Site connectivity issues affecting active construction operations are escalated ahead of office requests
Field teams may have limited connectivity alternatives
Coordinate with site managers for minimal disruption to construction operations
